server.name: Your Community
server.description: A friendly Discord community with organized support tickets.
server.rules: Be respectful, do not spam, and never share private credentials in tickets.
server.supportInfo: Support usually replies during business hours. Please include screenshots, IDs, order numbers or error messages when useful.

messages.noPermission: You do not have permission to use this.
messages.ticketAlreadyOpen: You already have an open ticket from this panel: {channel}
messages.notTicket: This channel is not an open ticket channel.
messages.outsideHoursNotice: Our team is currently outside business hours. You can leave your message here and we will reply as soon as possible.
messages.outsideHoursBlocked: Tickets are currently closed outside business hours. Please come back during business hours.
messages.dmTranscript: Here is the transcript for your ticket: {ticketName}
messages.dmTranscriptFailed: I could not DM the transcript to the ticket owner.
messages.aiDisabled: AI replies are disabled or not configured for this ticket.

ai.systemPrompt: You are the support assistant for this Discord server. Be clear, polite, practical and safe. Use the server information below when answering.
ai.serverInfo: Add your products, services, links, rules, prices, plans, staff notes or common fixes here.
knowledgeBase: Ask for screenshots or error messages when the issue is unclear.
Never ask users for passwords, tokens, full card numbers or private keys.
If a staff member is needed, say that the team will review the ticket.

styles.friendly: Answer in a friendly, simple and helpful support tone. Keep it short.
styles.professional: Answer professionally and clearly. Ask one focused follow-up question when needed.
styles.technical: Answer like a technical support agent. Give practical steps and avoid guessing.
styles.short: Answer in two or three short sentences.

ai.safety: Never ask for passwords, tokens, payment cards or private keys. Tell the user to remove secrets if they post them.

support.title: Support Center
support.description: Need help? Select the category that best matches your request. A team member will review your ticket as soon as possible.
support.subtitle: Before opening a ticket
support.subtitleText: Please choose the correct category and describe your issue clearly. This helps the team reply faster.

fields.name: What to include
fields.value: Explain what happened, what you expected, and include screenshots or IDs when useful.

fields.name: Privacy
fields.value: Do not share passwords, tokens, private keys or full payment details.

support.footer: One clear ticket is better than multiple duplicate tickets.

general.label: General Support
general.welcomeMessage: Thanks for opening a ticket. Please describe your request clearly and include useful screenshots, IDs or links.

billing.label: Billing
billing.welcomeMessage: Please explain your billing question. Do not share full card details, passwords or private payment credentials.

technical.label: Technical Help
technical.welcomeMessage: Please explain what happened, what you expected, and any error messages you saw.
